title: Measuring with shadows
body: During a project on indirect measurement, Class 10 students worked in the school ground. At 10 a.m., a vertical pole 6 m high cast a shadow 4 m long on level ground, and at the same moment the school's flag mast cast a shadow 10 m long. In the evening, a street lamp fixed 4.8 m above the ground lit the path. Riya, who is 1.2 m tall, started at the foot of the lamp-post and walked straight away from it at a steady speed of 1 m/s. The students noted that the sun's rays and the lamp's rays travel in straight lines, so each vertical object, its shadow and the ray through its top form a right triangle, and two such triangles sharing the same ray angle are similar by the AA criterion.
